---
title: "Setup"
---

The tutorial uses Unix-style command-line tools. The examples should run directly on Linux and macOS. Windows users can use Windows Subsystem for Linux, Git Bash, Cygwin, or adapt the commands to PowerShell.

## Core tools

```{bash}
# macOS
brew install wget imagemagick poppler
```

```{bash}
# Debian/Ubuntu Linux
sudo apt install wget imagemagick poppler-utils python3-venv
```

## Python environment

```{bash}
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install msstools deskew
```

## Quarto preview

```{bash}
quarto preview
```

## Publish with GitHub Pages

Render the site into the `docs/` directory:

```{bash}
quarto render
```

Then configure GitHub Pages to serve from the `docs/` folder on your main branch.
